name: build fwd harness
command: cat /tmp/fwd.c | ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cat > ~/bonsai2/asm/fwd.c && cd ~/bonsai2/asm && LB=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build/bin && gcc -O2 -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -DTQ_XGEMV_LIB -Dmain=tq_neon_main -c tq_gemv_neon.c -o fwd_neon.o 2>&1 | head -10 && gcc -O2 -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -c fwd.c -o fwd.o 2>&1 | head -20 && gcc -O2 -o fwd fwd.o fwd_neon.o fwht.S -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm 2>&1 | head -10 && echo BUILD_OK' 2>&1 | head -30
